description: List NFTs owned by an XRPL classic account using the native account_nfts method. Use this instead of list_account_objects when you need NFT-specific fields such as NFTokenID, Issuer, NFTokenTaxon, URI, and nft_serial. This is read-only and does not modify the ledger. Use ledger_hash or ledger_index to pin the ledger, and pass marker from a previous response to continue pagination.
name: n9t2_xrpl_list_account_nfts
